request.prompt:
Create a production-quality eight-direction neutral standing sprite reference sheet for the EXACT little fire-talisman Taoist boy in the reference image shown immediately above. Preserve his original very cute chibi identity: enormous rounded head, huge amber-brown eyes, very short compact body and short legs, soft round youthful cheeks, warm chestnut spiky hair with a high tied ponytail/topknot, ornate small gold crown with a red gem and red ribbons. Match the reference's polished hand-painted Chinese fantasy RPG illustration, crisp painted edges, warm highlights, rich but readable red/gold/black fabric. Do not redesign as an older child, teenager, adult, long-legged hero or realistic human.
Exact costume and props: scarlet and gold open short Taoist robe with flame-pattern gold-trimmed lower panels, white/ivory sleeve cuffs with black inner lining, black inner clothes and black loose trousers, large round black-white yin-yang gold waist medallion with a central red tassel, chunky red-black-gold shoes. The boy's anatomical RIGHT hand always carries a small fan of red rectangular talismans with gold flame emblems; his anatomical LEFT hand always carries the same small engraved brass ritual handbell with its red tassel. Their ownership NEVER swaps on turning. Keep both arms relaxed below shoulders, the talisman fan held close to right hip and the bell low beside left hip; natural relaxed neutral standing, feet both planted, not an attack, casting, jump or walk contact. Preserve all props in back views with correct occlusion.
Layout: a clean uniform TWO-ROW FOUR-COLUMN sheet, eight independent full-body drawings, ONE character centered in each equal square cell, read row-major as N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW. N means straight away from viewer showing the back with no visible face; NE means facing upper-right with mostly back and rightward silhouette; E means exact right-facing profile, nose to image right; SE means front three-quarter facing lower-right; S means straight front facing viewer; SW front three-quarter facing lower-left; W exact left-facing profile; NW mostly back facing upper-left. Consistent camera elevation, same head/body proportions, identical subject scale and neutral ground level across all eight cells. All whole silhouettes, hair, ribbons, cards, bell and shoes must fit comfortably inside their own cell with generous empty margin, no clipping or neighboring overlap.
Use a wide 2:1 canvas suitable for square cells. Background everywhere must be perfectly flat vivid solid magenta #FF00FF, no gradients, no texture, no floor, no ground shadow, no cast shadow, no aura or particles. No labels, letters, numbers, borders, dividers, captions or grid lines. This is a direction turnaround sprite sheet, not eight different designs.
